text: Need a straight answer please. My stepson, 4, temp 39.2. He's got spots that don't fade when I press a glass on them. He's got dark skin so they're hard to see on his body, but I checked his palms and soles and pulled down his eyelids and there are little dark red pinprick dots there too. He's also really not himself, very floppy and I had to shake him and call his name a few times before he'd open his eyes, which isn't him. He's weeing normally, nappy pull-up was wet an hour ago. Do I call 999 or drive him in?
